path.description: Where to read, such as /users/alice. Leave it out for the root.

shallow.description: Only the keys of the children, each as true. Default: true at the root without a query, else false. Can't be combined with a query.

orderBy.description: $key, $value, $priority or a child such as score or address/city; the others need it. A child needs .indexOn in the database's rules.

limitToFirst.description: The first children in orderBy's order; the endpoint caps it.

limitToLast.description: The last children in orderBy's order; the endpoint caps it.

startAt.description: Children from this value of orderBy on.

endAt.description: Children up to this value of orderBy.

equalTo.description: Children whose value of orderBy is this.
